purpose: Finite-window E0 pilot; not a steady-state or hardware claim
fill_definition: live mapped bytes / exposed logical capacity; first contiguous region
fio_compatibility: fio 3.36 uniform is the default random distribution; do not pass unsupported random_distribution=uniform
gate: Before any measurement, preconditioning gc-write-pages and block-erases must both increase; otherwise stop unchanged and report
interpretation: Strong local pilot support requires valid equal bytes, GC in all runs, same observed baseline, same direction in all pairs, both mean WAF and erase/GiB differences >=10%, and effect >3 pooled sample SD. Smaller consistent differences give limited support; invalid or inconsistent runs are inconclusive. No hardware/LEDGER policy claim.
